master_prompt: Convert the input image into a high-quality 2D digital illustration in the signature 'Hades' indie game art style. This is a strict STYLE CONVERSION: preserve the original character identity, pose, and composition. The final art must feature thick, expressive black ink lines, high-contrast lighting, and vibrant color highlights against deep shadows. The result should look like a professional, hand-drawn character portrait with a graphic, bold, and mythological aesthetic.

meta.intent: Image style conversion to Hades-inspired art
meta.target_style: Indie Game Art / Hades aesthetic / Graphic Inking
meta.avoid: Photorealism, 3D renders, soft painterly gradients, anime/manga styles

rules: Preserve character identity, pose, and silhouette
Convert the rendering technique from the source image to the Hades aesthetic
User instructions override source image details when specified

inking_phase: Redraw with bold black expressive outlines
Use varied line weight: thick outer silhouettes, delicate inner details
Integrate solid black shapes in hair, fabric folds, and deep shadows (spot blacks)
Apply sharp, angular ink strokes that define form and motion
shading_phase: Apply hard-edged cel-shading with no soft gradients
Use strong geometric shadow planes to sculpt the face and body
Combine dark shadow blocks with vibrant, high-saturation highlights
coloring_phase: Use a vibrant, high-contrast palette: Gold, Deep Crimson, Electric Purple, and Teal
Incorporate glowing magical effects or embers if applicable
Keep skin tones stylized and graphic, avoiding realistic textures

line_art.description: Bold, expressive, and varied black inking inspired by graphic novels and Greek pottery silhouettes
details: Solid black sections for deep shadows and hair depth

rules: Strictly no soft shading or airbrushed effects
Shadows must be sharp, angular, and defined
Cast shadows must be solid and bold
Deep, near-black values in shadow areas
Strict 60/30/10 distribution applied to the new style
Preserve face identity but apply graphic lineart
Sharp, defined facial planes (jaw, nose, cheekbones)

internal_logic: Reinterpret the source image using the 'Hades' game art DNA: Bold inking, vibrant color pops, high-contrast lighting, and 2D graphic excellence. Ensure the character looks like a legendary hero or god from a stylized indie masterpiece.
final_output_instruction: Generate only the final converted image. No text commentary.
